inputs.question: What limits the range of electric aircraft?

Which certification rules constrain battery-electric flight range?
How efficient is electric propulsion compared with turbines?

output.summary: Cell-level energy density is the binding limit.

output.title: What limits the range of electric aircraft
output.summary: Battery energy density, roughly 250 to 300 Wh/kg against about 12,000 Wh/kg for jet fuel, is the binding limit; efficient motors recover only part of the gap.
output.body_markdown:
## Energy density

Cells store roughly 250 to 300 Wh/kg [1], while jet fuel stores about 12,000 Wh/kg [2][3].

## Propulsion

Electric motors convert over 90% of electrical energy into shaft power [4].

## Not verified

A claimed 30-minute reserve rule for battery-electric aircraft could not be verified.
